decision_conditions: <p>Prior to the first installation of the Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP), the details of the ASHP shall be submitted to the planning authority for approval.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To protect acceptable local noise levels.</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>The use hereby permitted, or the operation of the ASHP shall not commence until a post-installation noise assessment has been carried out to confirm compliance with the noise criteria. The scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and attenuation measures, and they shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order for the duration of the use and their operation.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and the surrounding area</p>

<p>THE ASHP shall be installed, together with any associated ancillary equipment, so as to prevent the transmission of noise and vibration into neighbouring premises. The rated noise level from the ASHP and ancillary equipment shall not increase the existing background noise level (10dB below) when measured 1m external from the nearest residential or noise sensitive premises.</p><p>An assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried out by a suitably qualified (IOA accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant,in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound,’ and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required noise levels shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval. The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON To protect acceptable local noise levels.</p>
description: Erection of a lower ground, rear wrap-around side extension with the installation of rooftop PVs and a new ASHP to the rear garden.
